name: Dreamer
ability: Each night, choose a player (not yourself or Travellers): you learn 1 good & 1 evil character, 1 of which is correct.
interaction: Chooses: 1 player, not themselves and not a Traveller. Learns: 2 character tokens: 1 good (Townsfolk/Outsider) and 1 evil (Minion/Demon); one is the chosen player's character.
drunk_or_poisoned: Both shown characters may be wrong (misinformation offered centrally; still 1 good and 1 evil).

rulings.text: For a good player show their character plus any Minion or Demon; for an evil player show their character plus any Townsfolk or Outsider, optionally one they are bluffing as.
Shows the player's character, e.g. a Mutant shows Mutant; a Philosopher who gained an ability shows Philosopher.
With the Vortox in play both characters must be wrong; the Dreamer should never be shown the Vortox.

test_scenarios.name: good target
test_scenarios.setup: Alice Dreamer, Bob Chef, Cara Butler, Dan Poisoner, Eve Imp. Night 1.
test_scenarios.actions: Alice chooses Bob; storyteller picks Baron as the evil token.

test_scenarios.name: evil target bluff
test_scenarios.setup: Alice Dreamer, Bob Chef, Cara Empath, Dan Poisoner (bluffing Monk), Eve Imp. Night 2.
test_scenarios.actions: Alice chooses Dan; storyteller picks Monk as the good token.

test_scenarios.name: poisoned dreamer
test_scenarios.setup: Alice Dreamer, Bob Chef, Cara Butler, Dan Poisoner, Eve Imp. Night 2.
test_scenarios.actions: Dan poisons Alice; Alice chooses Bob; storyteller picks misinformation Empath and Imp.
test_scenarios.expected: Alice learns Empath and Imp (neither is Bob's character).

test_scenarios.name: vortox
test_scenarios.setup: Alice Dreamer, Bob Oracle, Cara Mutant, Dan Witch, Eve Vortox. Night 2.
test_scenarios.expected: Both tokens wrong and never Vortox: e.g. Oracle and No Dashii.

test_scenarios.name: cannot choose traveller or self
test_scenarios.setup: Alice Dreamer, Bob Chef, Cara Thief (Traveller), Dan Poisoner, Eve Imp. Night 1.
test_scenarios.expected: Legal choices are Bob, Dan and Eve only.
